AN ORDINANCE ESTABLISHING A PROPERTY NUMBERING SYSTEM, PROPERTY NUMBERING MAP,DESIGNATION OF PROPERTY NUMBERS, PROVISIONS FOR NEW STRUCTURES, PROVISIONS FOR DISPLAYING OF PROPERTY NUMBERS, PROVISIONS FOR PENALTIES AND PROVISIONS FOR AN EFFECTIVE DATE FOR THE TOWN OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA; TO REPEAL CONFLICTING ORDINANCES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.

Be it ordained by the Town Council of Clermont, Georgia, as follows:

I. ESTABLISHING A PROPERTY NUMBERING SYSTEM IN THE TOWN OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA.

There is hereby established a property numbering system in the Town of Clermont, Georgia as follows:
1: The purpose of this Ordinance is to establish a property numbering system in the Town of Clermont, Georgia that will increase the efficiency and coordination of public safety agencies; fire, police, and ambulance, public utility companies, and improve the ability of the general public to locate residential and commercial structures within the Town of Clermont town limits.
2: The property numbering map entitled "Property Numbering Map, dated " is hereby adopted as the official numbering map of the Town of Clermont, and all property numbers assigned shall be assigned in accordance with this numbering map, and no other property numbers shall be used or displayed in the Town of Clermont, except numbers assigned in accordance with the official numbering map. The property numbering map shall be divided into four quadrants designating northeast, northwest, southeast, southwest. The
3: Property numbers for all residential and commercial structures shall be assigned by the Town Clerk in accordance with administrative procedures. A record of all property numbers shall be kept in the office of the Town Clerk.
4: on the property numbering map, Main Street (Old U.S. Highway 129) is hereby designated as the north-south axis, and King Street is hereby designated as the east-west axis. All property numbers’ shall _ be numbered consecutively beginning at the intersection of Main Street (Old U.S. Highway 129) and King Street along these two axes. Each block should be numbered by a one hundred (100) series of numbers beginning at the intersection of Main Street (Old U.S. Highway 129) and King Street. One whole number shall be assigned for every twenty (20) feet of ground whether improved property or vacant lot, with allowances for future property division. Beginning at the intersection of Main Street (Old U.S. Highway 129) and King Street preceeding away from the intersection, all property on the right side of any street shall be designated by an even number while all property on the left side of any street shall be designated by an odd number.
5: It shall be the duty of the property owner, occupant, or person in charge of any residential or commercial structure, to display a three digit number assigned by the Town Council, in a conspicious place that is legible and distinguishable from the street on which the front entrance is located. Numbers shall be a minimum of three (3) inches in height, of durable and visible material. 6:
All residence and commercial structures erected after the adoption of this Ordinance shall be assigned a number in accordance with the property numbering map and shall display such numbers as provided in Section 5 of this Ordinance.

In the event the owner or occupant or person in charge of any residential or commercial structure refuses to comply with the terms of this Ordinance by failing to affix the number assigned within 30 days after notification of assigned number(s) the Town Council shall have the assigned number(s) displayed according to the provisions in Section 5 of this Ordinance and with the cost of the materials and labor to be borne by the property owner, occupant or person in charge of the property.

- il. EFFECTIVE DATE:

This Ordinance shall be effective 30 days after its final passage. (12-16-82) Ill. ‘REPEALING CLAUSE: All Ordinances or parts of Ordinances in conflict herewith are expressly repealed.
